svg.title: Bhramari technical architecture
svg.desc: Repository-grounded system architecture for Smart India Hackathon SIH26021. Signed offline capture, modular FastAPI backend, encrypted evidence, Merkle anchoring, public passports, language providers and pilot extensions.

g.text: From a signed hive record to a verifiable honey passport.
Bearer JWT / JWKS · role + organization checks · schema validation · rate limits
One modular backend · SQLAlchemy transactions · append-only domain events
Event JSON → SHA-256 → Merkle checkpoint (≤500 events)
Local volume in Compose · DB in demo
SQLite WAL outbox · signed tx retries · receipt callback
Immutable roots + counts · inclusion proof · chain receipt
Core registry contracts are not wired to API business writes.
Anchor receipt returns to API checkpoint state
Sarvam: STT + translation + TTS · ElevenLabs: TTS
Provider adapters require credentials; text fallback remains.
QR → serial → origin / evidence / status / Merkle proof
Web sign-in → token → API JWKS verification
Enrolled users + organization roles · device revocation
PostgreSQL dump + volume backups + SHA-256 manifest
TypeScript / Next.js build · Flutter analysis + tests
CodeQL · Trivy · dependency audits · CycloneDX SBOM
Configured infrastructure: Mosquitto MQTT + MinIO object store (application adapters pending)
Planned: ESP32 / HX711 gateway · Besu QBFT consortium · live IVR/OTP · validated pollen / acoustic models
Record integrity is not chemical purity. Sensor outputs support human screening.
Source-reviewed prototype · Compose deployment validation pending
